contextualize_findings_with_literature.description:
Map each row of the upstream findings table (DE genes / called peaks /
called variants) to PMID-anchored prior-work rows. Emit
claims_evidence_matrix.csv with deterministic concordance flags
(same_direction / opposite_direction / no_prior_finding / unverifiable).
No synthesis; no narrative.

attributes.claim_boundary:
This atom emits row-level concordance flags ONLY. Each row references one
upstream finding (finding_id), zero or more prior PMIDs, and a closed-set
concordance flag whose semantics are: same_direction iff the prior's effect
direction matches the analysis effect direction AND both effect-size
magnitudes are >0; opposite_direction iff signs differ; no_prior_finding
iff zero prior rows for this entity in this tissue; unverifiable iff prior
rows exist but their evidence_quote does not specify a direction. Do NOT
introduce composite or narrative claims. Do NOT generate paragraphs that
the upstream atom did not also generate row-wise.

EVIDENCE GATING (MANDATORY; enforced by post-task validation): cite a prior
PMID — and assert same_direction / opposite_direction / unverifiable — ONLY
for a PMID that has a DOWNLOADED evidence snapshot you can point to (a
snapshots/<sha256> file recorded in an evidence/manifest.json, either this
task's own or an upstream literature task's such as review_prior_work /
survey_method_landscape). Before writing ANY PMID into
claims_evidence_matrix.csv, confirm it resolves to such a manifest entry; if it
does not, DROP the citation and set that row to no_prior_finding (leave the
prior PMID column empty). NEVER cite a PMID from memory, from the finding's
gene/region/variant name, or one you have not actually retrieved — an
unretrieved PMID is an unsupported claim and will block the workflow. Record
every PMID you DO cite as an entry in THIS task's evidence/manifest.json
(reuse the upstream snapshot path) so downstream validation resolves it.

Gene-identity rule (MANDATORY): gene symbols MUST be resolved to Ensembl IDs
using the run's pinned genome annotation (org.Hs.eg.db / biomaRt at the
package's Ensembl release), OR by joining on the Ensembl IDs already present
in the upstream differential-expression table (de_results.tsv gene_id column).
You MUST NOT hardcode Ensembl IDs and you MUST NOT recall them from memory; do
not embed a literal symbol→Ensembl map in the script. You MUST NOT fall back to
a literal ID when a lookup fails — on lookup failure, mark the gene unresolved
rather than guessing. Resolution goes through the pinned annotation/adapter or
the upstream table only. Every emitted finding_id must be an Ensembl ID that
appears in the upstream DE table or is explicitly flagged absent. For every
gene row, ALSO populate the `entity` column with that gene's HGNC symbol (and
entity_kind = gene), carried straight from the same annotation join used for
the Ensembl id — so the independent gene-symbol↔Ensembl consistency check can
confirm the citation is attached to the right gene.

data_import.description:
Import structured tabular or domain-formatted inputs (CDISC ADaM/SDTM, time-series
panels, pre-computed count matrices) supplied by the SME. Mirrors `data_acquisition`
but for the clinical-trial and time-series-forecast project classes where inputs
are files-on-disk rather than repository accessions.

final_reporting.description:
Assemble the project-level final report: cross-stage narrative, dashboard
index, key figures, methods + caveats. Final node before SME review.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Findings-first: lead with the validated result rows and the
biological_interpretation narrative (when present), then methods and
caveats. Restate findings exactly as produced by upstream validated
tasks — every claim traces to an emitted result row or to an
interpretation statement that itself cites one. Do not introduce
claims that aren't backed by an emitted artifact; do not soften or
strengthen effect-size language; do not recommend methods the
pipeline did not run.

This report is the read-and-evaluated deliverable, so carry the upstream
substance FORWARD into it rather than collapsing to a thin digest: the
findings, their interpretation, and the data/source grounding the
upstream tasks already recorded must appear in the report itself, not be
left behind in per-task outputs or the trace. This is faithful
re-emission under the trace-to-artifact rule above — NOT license to pad
with generic prose, and NOT license to add any finding, theme, value, or
citation that no upstream artifact produced (an unsupported addition is a
fabrication, worse than an omission). Generic reporting discipline only;
do not tailor content to any external grading rubric.

reporting.description:
Assemble narrative tables, figures, and summary text from upstream stage
outputs into a per-stage HTML / Markdown report. Modality-agnostic; bio
taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

review_prior_work.description:
Retrieve prior literature (PMC OA full-text XML by default, broader via
ECAA_LIT_SOURCE_SCOPE) on the analysis's target entities + tissue +
modality. Emit a structured prior_claims_matrix.csv where every row is
PMID-anchored with a substring-verified evidence_quote. No biological
synthesis, no narrative review.

attributes.claim_boundary:
Every row in prior_claims_matrix.csv is a verbatim quote from one PMID's
available source text (PMC OA full-text XML, abstract, or — under explicit
scope — a locally-fetched PDF). Do NOT paraphrase, summarize, or synthesize
across PMIDs. Do NOT assert biological fact, mechanism, or causation. Do NOT
assert whether the prior work agrees or disagrees with anything — that is
the downstream contextualization atom's role, and even there it is row-wise
mechanical, not narrative. Rows whose evidence_quote does not exactly
substring-match the retrieved source are emitted with verified=false and
surface as BlockerKind::ValidationFailed { LiteratureClaim }.

time_series_decompose.description:
Decompose a time-series panel into trend / seasonality / residual
components and run stationarity diagnostics. Method-neutral: the
concrete decomposition (STL, classical additive/multiplicative,
X-13ARIMA-SEATS) is selected at runtime by the agent. Closes
Phase 6.1 B.1 of the dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan —
the time_series_forecast archetype previously had no producer for
this stage and dispatch failed with GoalUnreachable.

time_series_forecast_evaluate.description:
Produce point forecasts + prediction intervals over the named
horizon and evaluate against a held-out window. Emits a tabular
forecast table tagged as a statistical estimate (data:0951) so
the v4 planner can match it to the
`time_series_forecast` archetype goal. Closes Phase 6.1 B.1 of
the dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan.

time_series_model_fit.description:
Fit a forecasting model family (ARIMA / state-space / exponential
smoothing / Prophet) to the decomposed panel. Method-neutral: the
concrete model family is chosen at runtime by the agent based on
the SME-named model and series characteristics; the atom emits a
fitted-model artifact consumed by the downstream forecast-evaluate
atom. Closes Phase 6.1 B.1 of the
dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan.
